g.text: Reference standards for height by age, as defined by the World Health Organization. A child is considered

text.style: font-size: 10.08px; font-family: 'Lato', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; fill: #555555

g.text: “stunted” if their height is more than 2 standard deviations below the median for children of the same age.
